<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/trailers/{trailerId}/seals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



`INTACT` records the seal number found on the doors; `APPLIED` records a seal put on at the origin or dock; `BROKEN` marks it broken and places a SEAL_BROKEN hold. `sealClass` (I, S or H, ISO 17712) is optional with INTACT and APPLIED: an unknown class is 422 `invalid-seal-class`, and when the site yard policy sets `minimumSealClass` a seal of a lower class, or with no class, is 409 `seal-class-too-low`. `VERIFIED` and `MISMATCH` are never recorded by a caller: SealCheckAtGate sets them at check-in (ADR 0012).
